research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Virtru is focused on developing methods and systems for securing data access and distribution. Their research includes securing containerized applications by intercepting IP requests, distributing encrypted cryptographic data through a key service, and restricting data access based on process and machine properties. These efforts align with their mission to protect sensitive data in email, files, and SaaS applications, ensuring secure data flow in and out of businesses.

overview_description.description: Virtru offers end‑to‑end encryption and access control for emails, file sharing, and SaaS workflows. It secures messages and attachments within Gmail and Outlook via browser plugins, enabling features like revocation, expiration, watermarking, and downloadable restrictions. The platform extends encryption to files shared via Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, and secure SaaS apps, while enabling hosted or on-premises key management through its Private Keystore. With attribute‑based access controls, persistent policy enforcement, and audit visibility, Virtru allows organizations to maintain sovereignty over shared data without disrupting existing workflows.

about_short_description.short_description: Virtru provides data encryption for email and file sharing, enabling users to easily control access to their sensitive data.

product.name: Virtru Data Security Platform
product.description: A data-centric security platform that encrypts and governs access to emails, files, SaaS data, and mission applications using persistent policies and attribute-based access controls.

product.name: Virtru Email Protection
product.description: End-to-end email and attachment encryption for Gmail and Microsoft Outlook, with access controls such as expiration, forwarding restrictions, auditing, and revocation.

product.name: Virtru Secure Share
product.description: A cloud-based secure file-sharing service for encrypting documents, controlling external access, monitoring usage, and revoking permissions after files are shared.

product.name: Virtru Collaborate
product.description: A governed workspace for storing, organizing, sharing, and auditing sensitive files with internal and external collaborators.

product.name: Virtru Gateway
product.description: A server-side data protection gateway that automatically encrypts and applies access policies to email and data exchanged through business systems and SaaS applications.

product.name: Virtru Private Keystore
product.description: A key-management solution that lets organizations host and control private encryption keys while applying policy-based access to protected data.
